questions.questionHtml:
(sec2 x-cosec2x) [ 
cos2x (sinx+cosx)_________cosec2x (sinx-cosx)

sin2x (sinx-cosx)_________sec2 x(sinx+cosx)

options.text: sin 2 xcos 2 x sin 2 xcos 2 x

questions.solution:
(sec2 x - cosec2 x) = (sin2 x - cos2 x)/(sin2 x cos2 x)

(cos2 x(sinx+cosx)/(cosec2 x(sinx-cosx))+(sin2 x(sinx-cosx))/(sec2 x(sinx+cosx))(sec2 x-cosec2 x) = (sinx + cosx)2 + (sinx - cosx)2

= 2(sin2x + cos2x) = 2

questions.question: If tan A = 1 - cos B _________ sin B , then tan 2A is equal to: यदि 1 - cos B _________ sin B है, तो tan 2A किसके बराबर है:
questions.questionHtml:
If tan A =  
1 - cos B_________sin B
 , then tan 2A is equal to: 

यदि 
1 - cos B_________sin B
  है, तो tan 2A किसके बराबर है:
questions.solution:
tan A =  
1 - cos B_________sin B
  =  
2 sin2 (B/2)_________2 sin (B/2) cos (B/2)
  =  
sin (B/2)_________cos (B/2)

= tan (B/2)

So, A = B/2 and 2A = B

so tan (2A) = tan B
